description: This file implements a command-line interface tool (CLI) for a wizard process, including options parsing, error handling, network communication with a gateway via WebSocket, and interactive user prompts for guiding through a wizard workflow.

classes.name: GatewayWizardClient
classes.description: An asynchronous actor managing WebSocket connection to a gateway for a wizard protocol, handling connection setup, message exchange, and authentication.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a WizardCliOptions struct.

methods.name: runWizardCommand
methods.description: Main function to execute the wizard process based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and performs the initial handshake.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request and waits for a response over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes the payload of a response frame into a specific type.

methods.name: decodeFrame
methods.description: Decodes WebSocket messages into GatewayFrame objects.

methods.name: sendConnect
methods.description: Performs the connect handshake, including authentication, with the gateway.

methods.name: waitForConnectChallenge
methods.description: Waits for a challenge nonce during the connect process.
